intent: Inspect an online order payment before fulfillment.

required_real_data.value_reference: must come from MealScout order system
must come from MealScout vendor record

action.description: Check payment status before order fulfillment. Customer pays processing plus $1 MealScout fee.

fail_safes: Do not fulfill without paid status.
Do not invent order or vendor records.
Do not absorb customer-paid processing into MealScout margin.
